newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU cuts stake in Roto Smeets.
newsitem.headline: VNU cuts stake in Roto Smeets.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Wednesday it will sell about 364,000 shares in printing group Roto Smeets De Boer NV.
"This will decrease VNU's stake in Roto Smeets De Boer by about 12 percent to about 15 percent," VNU said in a statement.
The shares will be sold to venture capital group Parcom Ventures BV at a price which is fractionally below the market average of the last few days, it added.

VNU said Roto Smeets De Boer will also prematurely redeem two loans it had received from VNU. This involves an 18 million guilder subordinated convertible bond carrying an eight percent coupon and a subordinated loan of 50 million guilders with an interest rate of seven percent.

Roto Smeets De Boer, one of the Netherlands largest printers, said in September it expected further profit growth in the second half of 1996 after its first-half net more than doubled to 11.3 million guilders.
